items.name: builder-io
items.title: Builder.io
items.description: Visual page builder integration with Builder.io for no-code content editing.
items.docs: Visual page builder powered by Builder.io. Sign up at builder.io, add `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILDER_API_KEY` to `.env.local`, and wrap your Next.js config with `withBuilderConfig()`. Create pages visually in the Builder.io dashboard.

items.name: payload
items.title: Payload CMS
items.description: Payload CMS 3 wired into the app: config, collections, globals, blocks, seed data, admin UI routes, REST and GraphQL API routes, and the draft preview route.
items.docs: Payload CMS with the ShipKit collections (Pages, Media, Users, FAQs, Features, Testimonials, RBAC, VercelDeployments) and the Settings global. Admin UI at `/cms`, API at `/cms-api`. Set `DATABASE_URL` and `PAYLOAD_SECRET` (`PAYLOAD_PUBLIC_DRAFT_SECRET` enables draft preview). Overwrites the Bones stubs `src/payload.config.ts`, `src/lib/payload/payload.ts`, `src/lib/utils/get-payload-content.ts` and `src/payload-types.ts`; run with --overwrite. Needs `"@payload-config": ["./src/payload.config.ts"]` in tsconfig `paths` (Bones already has it) and `src/config/nextjs/with-payload.ts` is auto-loaded by Bones' Next.js plugin loader. After install run `pnpm payload generate:types`. Tables are created with the `shipkit_` prefix, so keep `DB_PREFIX=shipkit`.

items.name: cms-pages
items.title: CMS Pages
items.description: Shared catch-all route that renders dynamic pages from Payload CMS and/or Builder.io with automatic fallback.
items.docs: Shared CMS catch-all route at `src/app/(app)/[...slug]/page.tsx`. Checks Payload CMS first, then falls back to Builder.io, so both CMS systems coexist on the same URL space. Installs the `payload` and `builder-io` items as registry dependencies; `features-config` detects which CMS is enabled from env vars. Payload CMS needs `DATABASE_URL` and `PAYLOAD_SECRET`; Builder.io needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILDER_API_KEY`.

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth
items.description: Full authentication system with NextAuth.js v5, multi-provider OAuth, credentials, magic link, and guest access.
items.docs: Auth.js v5 auth system (Better Auth is ShipKit's default; this item is the Auth.js alternative). Set `APP_SECRET` (one secret derives `AUTH_SECRET` and the others) or run `npx auth secret` for `AUTH_SECRET`. Configure at least one OAuth provider (e.g. `AUTH_GITHUB_ID` + `AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET`) or enable guest access with `ENABLE_AUTH_GUEST=true`. Requires a database: set `DATABASE_URL` and run Drizzle migrations.

items.name: better-auth
items.title: Better Auth
items.description: Better Auth on the app's own user tables: server config, session facade, session service, React client, the strategy-aware useSession/signIn/signOut hook, OAuth buttons, provider, and the API route handler.
items.docs: Better Auth with email/password and GitHub/Google OAuth, reading and writing the app's own `users`, `accounts`, `sessions` and `verificationTokens` tables. Set `DATABASE_URL` and `APP_SECRET` (it derives `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`) or set `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` directly, and `BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL` if it differs from the site URL. `AUTH_STRATEGY=better-auth` makes it the active strategy behind `@/server/auth`; leave it unset and Better Auth is picked whenever nothing Auth.js-specific is configured. Add `AUTH_GITHUB_ID`/`AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` and/or `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`/`AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` for OAuth. The handler mounts at `/api/better-auth`. Run `pnpm db:push` so the nullable Better Auth columns exist on the auth tables.

items.name: clerk
items.title: Clerk
items.description: Clerk as the auth strategy: server session facade, client hooks, provider, request proxy with Clerk's middleware, prebuilt sign-in/sign-up/user-button components, and the strategy dispatch in the shared auth files.
items.docs: Clerk (hosted, paid) as the app's auth strategy. Create an application at https://dashboard.clerk.com and copy the publishable and secret keys from API Keys into `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` and `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` (`CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET` from Webhooks, if you add one). `AUTH_STRATEGY=clerk` turns it on; the keys alone do nothing, and Clerk is never picked automatically (Better Auth stays the default). `src/env.ts` must accept `"clerk"` in its `AUTH_STRATEGY` enum (Bones has it from shipkit-io/bones#107). Once on: `auth()`, `signIn()` and `signOut()` from `@/server/auth` and `useSession()` from `@/lib/auth/use-session` read Clerk, `src/config/providers/clerk.provider.tsx` mounts `ClerkProvider`, and `src/proxy.ts` runs `clerkMiddleware()` and forwards `/sign-in` and `/sign-up` to Clerk's hosted Account Portal (`next` becomes the return URL; a signed-in visitor goes to the dashboard). Set `publicMetadata.role` to `admin` on a user in the dashboard to make them an admin. Overwrites the Bones stubs `src/server/clerk/facade.ts` and `src/lib/auth/clerk-client.ts`, and the shared `auth-strategy.ts`, `session-mapping.ts`, `use-session.ts` and `server/auth.ts` (same content Bones ships). Not on: the proxy is a pass-through and the provider renders children unchanged.

items.name: legal
items.title: Legal Pages
items.description: Legal pages with privacy policy, terms of service, EULA, and legal information, all in MDX with shared layout and header navigation.
items.docs: Legal pages (privacy policy, terms of service, EULA, legal info) with MDX content and shared layout. Customize the content in each `.mdx` file after installation.

items.name: contact
items.title: Contact
items.description: Contact page with animated background, email card, and contact form with Resend email integration and newsletter opt-in.
items.docs: Contact page with form that sends emails via Resend. Set `RESEND_API_KEY` to enable email delivery. The form includes name, contact info, message, and optional newsletter opt-in.

items.name: admin
items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.description: Role-based admin panel with user management, payments, GitHub repos, integrations, feedback, waitlist, and CMS admin sections.
items.docs: Role-based admin dashboard. Set `ADMIN_EMAIL` (comma-separated) to grant admin access by email. Requires auth block for session management and database for user/role queries.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: User settings pages with profile, appearance, account management, sidebar navigation, and server actions for profile/theme updates.
items.docs: User settings with profile editing, appearance/theme picker, account deletion, and provider disconnect. Requires auth block for session management and database for persisting changes.

items.name: email
items.title: Email
items.description: Resend email integration with client setup, subscribe/audience actions, email service, and newsletter form component.
items.docs: Email integration via Resend. Set `RESEND_API_KEY` to enable. Optionally set `RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID` for newsletter audience management. Includes subscribe form component and email utility functions.

items.name: turnstile
items.title: Cloudflare Turnstile
items.description: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection: server-side token verification helper and a themed widget component.
items.docs: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection. Create a widget at dash.cloudflare.com, then set `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` (client) and `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` (server). Render `<Turnstile />` in a form and call `verifyTurnstileToken()` in the server action. The feature turns on automatically when both keys are set.

items.name: feedback
items.title: Feedback
items.description: User feedback system with dialog and popover components, server actions, and database-backed feedback service.
items.docs: User feedback collection with dialog and popover UI. Stores feedback in the database and optionally emails it via Resend. Requires `DATABASE_URL` for storage.

items.name: analytics
items.title: Analytics
items.description: Multi-provider analytics with PostHog, Umami, DataFast, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Statsig, all behind feature flags.
items.docs: Multi-provider analytics. Each provider auto-enables via env vars: `NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` (PostHog), `NEXT_PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID` (Umami), `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATAFAST_WEBSITE_ID` (DataFast), `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_ID` (Google Analytics), `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_GTM_ID` (GTM), `NEXT_PUBLIC_STATSIG_CLIENT_KEY` (Statsig). Add `<AnalyticsProvider />` to your root layout.

items.name: caching
items.title: Caching & Rate Limiting
items.description: Redis-based caching and rate limiting via Upstash with configurable per-route limits.
items.docs: Redis caching and rate limiting via Upstash. Set `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL` and `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN` to enable. Configure per-route rate limits in `config/rate-limits.ts`.

items.name: storage
items.title: Storage
items.description: File storage with AWS S3 presigned uploads, file service, server actions, and upload components.
items.docs: File storage via AWS S3 with presigned URL uploads. Set `AWS_REGION`, `AWS_BUCKET_NAME`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, and `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`. Vercel Blob (`VERCEL_BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`) is detected too but ships with the Payload CMS item. Includes file upload components and server actions for managing uploads. Overwrites the Bones stub `src/server/services/s3.ts`; run with --overwrite.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Pricing page with plan cards, features showcase, testimonials, and static content data files.
items.docs: Pricing page with plan cards and feature comparison. Customize plans in `content/pricing/pricing-content.ts`, features in `content/features/features-content.ts`, and testimonials in `content/testimonials/testimonials-content.ts`.

items.name: payments
items.title: Payments
items.description: Unified payment system with Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, and Polar providers: checkout flows, webhook handlers, and subscription management.
items.docs: Unified payment system supporting Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, and Polar. Each provider auto-enables via env vars: `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` + `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` (Stripe, plus `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` for webhooks), `LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY` + `LEMONSQUEEZY_STORE_ID` (Lemon Squeezy), `POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN` (Polar). Includes webhook handlers, checkout flows, and subscription management. Requires `DATABASE_URL` for storing payment records. Overwrites the Bones stubs `src/server/providers/stripe-provider.ts`, `src/server/providers/lemonsqueezy-provider.ts`, `src/server/providers/polar-provider.ts` and `src/lib/lemonsqueezy/lemonsqueezy.ts`; run with --overwrite.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: User dashboard with projects, teams, API keys, deployments, downloads, tools, stats, and revenue chart.
items.docs: User dashboard with projects, teams, API keys, deployments, downloads, and analytics charts. Requires `auth` block for session management and `DATABASE_URL` for data persistence. Install `payments` block for subscription-aware features.

items.name: rbac
items.title: RBAC
items.description: Role-based access control with permission service, client-side hook, and API permission check endpoint.
items.docs: Role-based access control. Provides `rbacService.hasPermission(userId, resource, action)` on the server and `usePermission()` hook on the client. Requires `auth` block and `DATABASE_URL` for permission storage.

items.name: ai
items.title: AI
items.description: Browser-based AI with SmolLM via WebGPU and cloud AI with OpenAI: demo components, utilities, and worker scripts.
items.docs: AI integration with browser-based SmolLM (WebGPU, no server) and cloud AI (OpenAI, Anthropic). Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` for cloud AI. SmolLM runs entirely in-browser with no API key needed. Includes demo components and WebGPU detection utility.

items.name: github-connect
items.title: GitHub Connect
items.description: GitHub OAuth integration with repo creation, collaborator management, invitation checks, and download service.
items.docs: GitHub integration for repo management. Requires `AUTH_GITHUB_ID` + `AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` for OAuth. Provides repo creation, collaborator invitations, download service, and API routes for checking repo availability.

items.name: vercel-connect
items.title: Vercel Connect
items.description: Vercel integration with OAuth, deploy triggers, webhook handling, deployment status, and deploy button components.
items.docs: Vercel deployment integration. Set `VERCEL_INTEGRATION_SLUG`, `VERCEL_CLIENT_ID` and `VERCEL_CLIENT_SECRET` from your Vercel integration. Provides OAuth connect flow, deploy triggers, webhook receiver, deployment status tracking, and deploy button components.
